snippet.title: 川越まつり Kawagoe Festival 2026【お祭りライブ配信⛩️】宵宮の午前中🌞
snippet.description:
川越まつりは、埼玉県川越市の川越氷川神社の例大祭を源流に、蔵造りの町並みを絢爛豪華な山車が曳行し、神幸祭や曳っかわせを楽しめる370年以上続く祭礼です。Kawagoe Festival is a historic float festival featuring ornate dashi, sacred processions and thrilling hayashi performances in the old streets of Kawagoe.
川越まつりの様子をお届けします。
2026年は10月17日・18日に開催。神幸祭、提灯が灯る宵山、市役所前山車巡行、山車同士が囃子で競演する夜の「曳っかわせ」が大きな見どころです。

📌 詳しい特徴
川越氷川神社の祭礼を基礎に、江戸の天下祭の様式を受け継いだ「江戸系川越型」の山車が中心市街地を曳行します。二層の鉾と人形、迫り上げ機構、回転する囃子台が特徴で、山車が出会うと互いに正面を向け、笛・太鼓・鉦と舞で競演する「曳っかわせ」が行われます。2026年は26台の山車が参加予定です。

📜 歴史
起源は慶安元年1648年。川越藩主松平信綱が川越氷川神社へ神輿、獅子頭、太鼓などを寄進し祭礼を奨励したことに始まります。江戸との交流を背景に山車文化が発展し、2005年に「川越氷川祭の山車行事」が国指定重要無形民俗文化財、2016年にユネスコ無形文化遺産「山・鉾・屋台行事」の構成行事となりました。

🕰 歴史的時代背景
江戸の天下祭の影響を受けた城下町の都市祭礼で、新河岸川舟運などを通じた江戸との交流の中で独自の山車文化を形成しました。

埼玉県川越市中心市街地、川越一番街・川越市役所・川越氷川神社周辺

🚃 東武東上線 川越市駅から中心市街地へ徒歩約15分

🚗 臨時駐車場は両日8時30分～22時00分、23時00分施錠

🍜 屋台村　17日10時00分～21時30分、18日10時00分～21時00分
🚫 ドローン等の使用は原則禁止。会場内は左側通行、歩行喫煙禁止
🗑 ごみの分別・持ち帰りに協力

🏮 2026年は26台の山車が参加予定。各山車には町ごとの人形、彫刻、幕、提灯が施されます。
🙏 神幸祭では川越氷川神社の神輿が氏子区域を渡御します。
🎎 山車の現在位置は川越まつりナビで確認できます。

🎶 囃子台では舞1人、笛1人、小太鼓2人、大太鼓1人、鉦1人を基本に、王蔵流・芝金杉流・堤崎流などの囃子が受け継がれています。
🏆 曳っかわせは勝敗を競うものではなく、山車同士の挨拶として行う囃子の競演です。

⛩ 川越氷川神社
🙏 御祭神　素盞嗚尊、奇稲田姫命、大己貴命、脚摩乳命、手摩乳命

snippet.title: Tokyo Day Trip: Eel & Sweet Potato Kamameshi in Kawagoe | From Ikebukuro
snippet.description:
Eel, sweet potato, and freshly cooked rice—a lunch stop in Kawagoe 🍠

Still dressed in our kimonos, we stopped for lunch at Koedo Kamameshi Torisei, across from Toki no Kane, the historic bell tower.

Kamameshi is a Japanese rice dish cooked and served in an individual pot.
We tried a version topped with eel and sweet potato, one of Kawagoe’s local specialties.

Torisei dates back to 1898 and reopened in 2024 following a renovation, with a renewed focus on kamameshi.
Join us for a taste of Kawagoe during our day exploring Little Edo!

▼Don’t miss this one too

https://youtu.be/jKv39QNOXjw

🏡 Stay at KAGURA base in Ikebukuro
Add a day in Kawagoe to your Tokyo trip.
Head out from Ikebukuro in the morning, enjoy the old town and a local lunch, and return to the same accommodation that evening.

KAGURA base sleeps up to 8 guests and has a washing machine, making it a convenient base for longer trips with family or friends.

Address: 2-33-10 Ikebukuro, Toshima-ku, Tokyo, Japan

🚃 Getting there from Ikebukuro

1. Take the Tobu Tojo Line from Ikebukuro Station to Kawagoe Station. Faster services take around 30 minutes.
2. From Kawagoe Station’s East Exit, take a Tobu bus serving Ichibangai and get off there.
3. Torisei is a short walk from the bus stop, across from Toki no Kane.

The train journey time does not include the bus ride or walking time. Check train and bus schedules before setting off.

snippet.title: Kyoto but it's not Kyoto #japantrip #japanlife #trip #kawagoe #vlog #travel #kyoto
snippet.description:
Want to see Kyoto but you're in Tokyo ?
Let's visit Kawagoe, a pretty little city at 1 hour from Tokyo called "little Kyoto". 
You can walk in its parks and shrines during the morning and when you feel hungry, do not hesitate to cross the traditionnal street of Saitama Prefecture Rd 2. You'll see a lot of street food and cute shops. 

Voir Kyoto à juste une heure de Tokyo ?
Visitons ensemble Kawagoe, une magnifique petite ville qu'on appelle "le petit Kyoto". On peut visiter ses temples et parcs le matin, et quand la faim se fait ressentir, la rue traditionnelle "Saitama Prefecture Rd 2" a de quoi nous rassasier. On peut déambuler entre ses boutiques datant de la période d'Edo tout en savourant de la street food japonaise. Privilégiez les jours de semaine car les touristes envahissent les rues le week-end.

snippet.description:

**자막 기능을 선택하시면 상세 정보가 표시됩니다

카와고에는 경제와 문화 면에서 에도와 깊은 관계가 있어 '에도와 같은 마을(작은 에도)'이라는 의미에서 친밀감을 담아 '코에도(小江戶)'라고 불리고 있습니다. 

「쿠라즈쿠리」는 일본의 건축 양식의 하나로, 흙벽 곳간 자체, 또는 그것을 본뜬 형태 의 매장과 주거가 있다. 표면을 회반죽 등으로 만든 두꺼운 흙벽과 양쪽으로 여는 중후 한 문 등이 특징.

snippet.title: This Edo Period Street Is The Perfect Day Trip From Tokyo 🍡
snippet.description:
This is the Warehouse District in Kawagoe Town, Saitama Prefecture. Less than one hour from
Tokyo Station by train, this street transports you back to Japan’s Edo Period thanks to its well
preserved buildings and landmarks. 🔔

It’s also great for Japanese snack and sweets lovers, with food stalls scattered along the street and the famous Kashiya Yokocho “Candy Ally” selling lots of delicious Japanese sweets, including taiyaki (filled pastry shaped like a fish) and fugashi (brown sugar coated bread sticks).

Having been to Kawagoe multiple times, I always recommend @ugr_kawagoe for delicious umami
ramen! 🍜

snippet.description:
Explore the timeless beauty of Kawagoe, Japan, often referred to as "Little Edo." In this video, we take a journey through this historic city, famous for its well-preserved warehouse district (Kurazukuri), the iconic Toki no Kane (Time Bell Tower), and its charming traditional atmosphere.

Whether you are planning a trip to Japan or simply love exploring Japanese culture and history, Kawagoe offers a perfect day trip from Tokyo. From strolling down the atmospheric streets of Candy Alley (Kashiya Yokocho) to visiting ancient shrines and temples, discover why Kawagoe is a must-visit destination for travelers seeking an authentic glimpse into Japan’s past.

In this video:

• 08:00 숙소 출발, 09:15 가와고에
• 09:30 기모노 착용, 구라즈쿠리 거리 산책
• 12:00 점심: 우나기 덴베 + 길거리 음식

• 19:15 하라주쿠 저녁 (도보)
• 20:30 출발 → 21:15 오쿠보 입고, 숙소 근처 돈키호테 쇼핑

📅 10/18(일) 해리포터 → 아키하바라
• 07:45 숙소 출발 (08:40까지 도착 필수! 늦으면 입장 불가)
• 09:00~13:00 해리포터 스튜디오 투어
• 13:30 라멘 점심 (가게 미정)
• 14:30~18:30 아키하바라 쇼핑
• 19:30 야키니쿠 저녁 (가게 미정)

📅 10/19(월) 후지산 → 축제
• 07:00 출발 (후지산 약 2시간)
• 09:00 아라쿠라야마 센겐공원(충령탑)
• 10:30 가와구치코 호수·편의점 휴식
• 12:00 점심: 규카츠 코슈야(甲州家)
• 14:00 출발, 16:30 도쿄 복귀·차 입고
• 17:30 니혼바시 베타라시 축제 (전철 이동)
• 저녁은 상의 후 결정

📅 10/20(화) 귀국
• 07:30 숙소 출발
• 09:30 나리타 렌터카 반납 (주유 후)
• 10:30 체크인, 13:05 출발

snippet.description:
THIS JAPAN STILL EXISTS 🇯🇵

Today we walk through Kawagoe, one of the most beautiful historic towns near Tokyo.

Known as “Little Edo,” Kawagoe preserves the atmosphere of old Japan with traditional wooden buildings, historic streets, local shops, temples and the famous Toki no Kane (Bell Tower).

This walk takes us through busy streets filled with visitors and everyday Japanese life, from the traditional areas of Kurazukuri and Kashiya Yokocho to the modern streets near Kawagoe Station.

No talking. No narration.
Just a real walk through Japan in 4K HDR with natural ambient sound.
